# CodeMirror source editor

`amd/build/source_editor.min.js` contains the official CodeMirror 6 packages for JavaScript editing. The source modules, pinned dependency versions and integrity hashes are in `editor-src/`. Run `npm ci` and `npm run build` there to rebuild. Node.js is needed only for building.

CodeMirror packages use the MIT licence. The licence text is retained in `LICENSE`; bundled dependency sources remain available in the source map.
